10-13-2026 – Regular Board Meeting
The Sioux County Board of Supervisors will have a meeting on Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 9:00 AM. Click here to view the agenda.
10-07-2026 – Board of Health Meeting Agenda
The Sioux County Board of Health is meeting on October 14, 2026 at 8:00 AM at Community Health Partners in their conference room. Details about the meeting and the agenda can be found in the link. Meeting Agenda
10-07-2026 – Job Opening for Full-Time Motor Vehicle/Driver’s License Clerk
Join the Sioux County Treasurer’s department! We have an opening for a full-time Motor Vehicle/Driver’s License Clerk in Orange City. Follow the links in this post for details about the position and how to apply. Applications will be accepted and reviewed until the position is filled.
Job Posting – Job Description – Job Application
10-05-2026 – General Election Absentee Ballots
For the upcoming General Election on November 3, 2026, the Auditor’s office can now accept Absentee Ballot Request forms. The voter pre-registration deadline and the last day to request a mailed absentee ballot is October 19, 2026. The last day to vote in-person at the Courthouse before Election Day is Monday, November 2, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. General Election Sample Ballots can be viewed here
10-02-2026 – Notice of Public Hearing on Proposed Amendment to County Ordinance No. 1
A public hearing is scheduled for 9:00 AM on October 13, 2026, in the Board of Supervisors’ Room, Sioux County Court House, 210 Central Ave SW, Orange City, Iowa.
Meetings of Board of Supervisors at which proposed revisions to County Ordinance No. 1 will be considered:
The Sioux County Board of Supervisors will consider the passage of this proposed amendment to County Ordinance No. 1 at its September 29, 2026, meeting, after the public hearing scheduled for the same time and place has been held on proposed revisions to County Ordinance No. 1, should said ordinance amendments be passed at the meeting, the proposed revisions to the ordinance will be considered at a second Board of Supervisors’ meeting to be held on October 13, 2026, at 9:00 AM. Should the proposed amendment to County Ordinance No. 1 be approved at this second reading, the proposed amendment to Ordinance No.1 will be considered for a third and final time, on October 27, 2026, at 9:00 AM. If approved at this reading, it will then be published and will be effective upon publication.
